# Party

> Parties and matchmaking for co-op and lobby flows.

- Package: `Party` · Category: Social
- Starts at server boot: **yes, whenever installed** (it has work to do before its first call)
- Installing it also installs: [Friend](Friend.md), [InviteQueue](InviteQueue.md), [Memory](Memory.md), [Teleport](Teleport.md)
- Check it is installed: `GaxiaServer.IsInstalled("Party")` (server) / `Gaxia.IsInstalled("Party")` (shared/client keys)

## `GaxiaServer.Party`

- Runs: **server only (Script / server ModuleScript)**
- Source: `src/ServerStorage/Gaxia_Packages_Server/Lib/PartyService.lua`

Get it:

```lua
local GaxiaServer = require(game:GetService("ServerStorage").Gaxia_Packages_Server)
local Party = GaxiaServer.Party
```

- `Party.SetMaxSize(n: number): ()`
  Runtime override of party size; nil/unset falls back to Config.Party.MaxSize.

- `Party.QueueForMatch(partyId: string, matchType: string, placeId: number): (boolean, string)`
- `Party.Unqueue(partyId: string, matchType: string): ()`
- `Party.PollMatch(matchType: string, neededPlayers: number): MatchResult?`
  Pull oldest queued parties until `neededPlayers` is reached; if a full match forms, remove those parties from the pool, reserve a server, and return it.

### Signals

Connect with `:Connect(function(...) end)`; the parameters are the payload types, in order.

- `Party.OnPartyChanged` — `Signal<string>`
  (partyId)
- `Party.OnMatchFound` — `Signal<string, { PoolEntry }, string?>`
  (matchType, parties, accessCode)
- `Party.OnInvite` — `Signal<Player, string, string>`
  (toPlayer, partyId, fromName)
- `Party.OnInviteResponded` — `Signal<Player, number, boolean>`
  (leader, targetUserId, accepted)
